metadata.name: frontend-patterns
metadata.description: Frontend development patterns for React, Next.js, state management, performance optimization, and UI best practices.

source_provenance.upstream_revision: not available in the local provenance snapshot

strengths: Concrete React composition, hooks, forms, error and accessibility examples
Useful state, performance and responsive implementation vocabulary
Small enough to route as domain guidance despite broad activation wording
weaknesses: No package identity/version or native manifest
No executable tests, evidence lineage, browser/render matrix or stop contract
Illustrative fetch/error examples omit cancellation, schema validation and retry policy
Broad React/Next trigger can load before stack and boundary are known
portability_debt: Coupled to React/TypeScript and DOM semantics
No guidance for existing non-React web stacks
No dependency, browser, SSR/hydration or runtime support matrix
No explicit separation from design direction, verification or final security authority
